page.layout: Two columns of index entries on one printed page, left and right. A fragment at the top of the left column and a continuation line at the top of the right column. No page number. The running head "INDEX" stands at the top. A catchword "dolus" sits at the lower right, below the last right-column line.

page.notes: Long s is printed as s or as an f-like form in places (for example "potest", "§.fi."); transcribed as plain s. "vt" is changed to "ut" throughout. Doubtful: "Constituta ut liber" (the printed word is hard to make out, read as "vtilitèr" or similar); "1.13c" at the end of the last line (could be 1.136 or 1.134); "in si." at the top is a line fragment whose sense depends on the previous column. The "D" and the initial letter of "Damnum" are the section letter and a large initial, joined to the word as the rules require. "dolus" at the lower right is the catchword.
